wrapper.name: SCDraw_Clock
wrapper.text:
---- MODULE SCDraw_Clock ----
EXTENDS Clock
LOCAL INSTANCE Naturals
SCDraw_Clock_TLC == INSTANCE TLC
SCDraw_Clock_Budget == SCDraw_Clock_TLC!TLCGet("distinct") <= 500
SCDraw_Clock_Broken == {}
SCDraw_Clock_Mark == IF SCDraw_Clock_Broken = {} THEN TRUE ELSE SCDraw_Clock_TLC!PrintT(<<"00000000000000000000000000000000", <<mode, ticks>>, SCDraw_Clock_Broken>>)
====
